title: 2022 building code energy and accessibility standards adopted (New South Wales)
summary: NSW raised its BASIX thermal and energy standards to the NCC 2022 level from 1 October 2023 and did not adopt the livable housing provisions.

instruments.title: State Environmental Planning Policy (Sustainable Buildings) 2022 (BASIX)
instruments.provisions: BASIX standards in place of NCC 2022 energy provisions (instrument dates not checked)

commenced.what: BASIX energy standard raised to the NCC 2022 level (7 stars); livable housing not adopted

direction_rationale: The 2022 code raised minimum energy performance for new homes to 7 stars and added livable housing design requirements. Design and compliance costs are partly fixed per dwelling and may fall hardest on small builders, lowering entry and raising exit.
comparison: Staggered and partial adoption 2023-2025 (NSW and WA did not adopt the livable housing provisions)
